name: Batch-augmented and wavelet steps (blep_bas, blep_weoon)
plain: Two experiments of blepping's. blep_bas runs the model on a larger batch built from the latent for its first few steps (0 to 3 by default) and folds the results back. blep_weoon splits the step in wavelet bands and blends them separately; it needs pytorch_wavelets.
math:
bas: batch ×2 by default for steps 0 to 3, renoise mode restart, simple or restart_noneta.
weoon: DWT of the update; low band and high bands blended with their own modes, then inverse DWT.

providers.author: blepping
providers.note: Not installed here. We ran it in a separate, throwaway ComfyUI for the blepping page; this entry is from reading the code at commit d8574ba.
